response.overview: The story depicts a village in chaos when Pak Usop reveals a story about Tok Jidin, a shaman in the village who passed away 100 days ago. He is subsequently linked to the presence of his pet ghost haunting their village. Adding to this are accounts from villagers who claim to have seen a long-haired, sarong-wearing apparition roaming about. Fifie, the village chief's daughter, jokingly challenges her boyfriend Azlim to bring the ghost to her if he truly loves her. Accepting the challenge, Azlim meets with Pak Akob and jokingly states that a nail he borrowed was once used to capture a pontianak.
response.title: Kau, Aku, Hantu Raya
